public_rationale: Practical benefits were documented, including greater independence for some blind users and reported workplace productivity gains. But the claim permits a few successes. statement.excerpt: As we speak, there are few if any meaningful improvements to our lives as a result of the last year's artificial intelligence boom.

from_speaker: few if any meaningful improvements to our lives
as a result of the last year's artificial intelligence boom
our_interpretation: The context concerns generative AI introduced or adopted during the preceding year.
Meaningful improvements means practical benefits such as greater independence, better work, or appreciable time savings.
Few if any permits some successful applications. Finding individual benefits does not establish that benefits were widespread.
The preceding year is interpreted as 18 March 2023 through publication.
criteria.support_condition: Broad evidence shows that practical benefits remained rare across people's everyday activities during the specified year.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence establishes widespread practical improvements attributable to generative AI during that year, beyond isolated applications or selected early adopters.

evidence.explanation: Microsoft surveyed 297 customer respondents in its early-access program between October 3 and November 2, excluding those with under three weeks of use. The results show reported benefits within a selected group, not their prevalence in the general population.
